source.title: Settings
source.description: Full reference - every setting under `[tool.uv]` and `[tool.uv.*]` sub-tables in `pyproject.toml`/`uv.toml`, with defaults and TOML examples. Grep by setting name (≈11k words)

source.title: CLI Reference
source.description: Full reference - every command, subcommand, argument and option with defaults and `UV_*` equivalents. Grep by command, never read whole (≈102k words)

source.title: Environment variables
source.description: Full reference - Every environment variable uv defines or respects: `UV_*` flags, S3/GCS/Azure endpoints, proxy, TLS, XDG, shell and CI detection.

source.title: Features
source.description: Map of uv's command families — `uv python` versions, `uv run` scripts, project commands (`init`, `add`, `sync`), `uvx` tools, legacy `uv pip`, and cache utilities.

source.title: Working on projects
source.description: Beginner walkthrough: `uv init`, what each generated file is for, adding/removing/upgrading packages, migrating `requirements.txt`, `uv run` versus activating `.venv`, and `uv build`.

source.title: Managing dependencies
source.description: Concept guide to uv add/remove, dev groups, optional extras, Git/path/URL/index sources, platform markers, editable installs and version specifiers.

source.title: Running commands in projects
source.description: `uv run` executes commands in the auto-synced project `.venv`; `--with` per-invocation dependency overrides, isolated PEP 723 inline-metadata scripts, and signal forwarding.

source.title: Configuration files
source.description: `[tool.uv]` in `pyproject.toml` versus `uv.toml`, project/user/system merge precedence, opting out via `--no-config` or `--config-file`, dotenv loading with `--env-file`, and `uv pip`-only `[tool.uv.pip]`.

source.title: Python versions
source.description: Managed versus system interpreters, `.python-version` pins and discovery order, `uv python install`/`find`/`upgrade` commands, request formats for free-threaded and debug variants, plus `python-preference` and `python-downloads` settings.

source.title: Building and publishing a package
source.description: Tutorial: bumping versions with `uv version`, PyPI tokens or trusted publishing, TestPyPI and custom indexes, retrying partial uploads, attestations, and testing the install.

source.title: Using uv with pre-commit
source.description: Short guide to the official .pre-commit-config.yaml hooks that keep uv.lock current, sync requirements.txt from the lockfile, and compile requirements.in files.

source.title: Using uv with Jupyter
source.description: Jupyter via `uv run --with jupyter`, dedicated `ipykernel` kernels, and how `!uv add`, `!uv pip install` and `%pip` target different environments; plus VS Code.

source.title: Installing and managing Python
source.description: `uv python install` for specific versions or PyPy, versioned-only executables unless `--default`, plus `list`, `--reinstall`, preview `upgrade`, automatic downloads, and `--no-managed-python` to force system Python.

source.title: Project structure and files
source.description: `pyproject.toml` metadata, the gitignored `.venv` managed by `run` and `sync` (plus `centralized-project-envs` preview caching), and the committed cross-platform `uv.lock` versus tool-agnostic `pylock.toml` exports.

source.title: Creating projects
source.description: Guide to `uv init` templates: app vs library, src layout, build backends, Rust/C++ extension modules, no-build-system and pyproject-only projects.

source.title: Locking and syncing
source.description: Automatic locking and syncing; opt out with `--locked`, `--frozen`, `--no-sync`. `uv lock --check`, `--inexact` pruning, extras and dependency-group selection, `--upgrade-package`, Docker partial installs, `uv export`.

source.title: Configuring projects
source.description: Concept guide: CLI entry points, packaged versus unpackaged projects, custom `.venv` path, flash-attn/torch build isolation failures, conflicting extras, lockfile platform limits.

source.title: Building distributions
source.description: Guide to `uv build` producing sdists and wheels, pinning build dependencies with hashes, and blocking accidental PyPI uploads of private packages.

source.title: The uv build backend
source.description: Concept guide to uv_build: setup, module layout, namespace and stub packages, and which files go into sdists and wheels; pure Python only.

source.title: Using uv with marimo
source.description: Four setups for marimo notebooks: `uvx marimo edit` standalone, `--sandbox` inline script metadata, `uv run` inside a project, or non-project `uv venv`.

source.title: Using uv in GitHub Actions
source.description: CI workflow guide: setup-uv, Python version matrix, caching, private repo dependencies, uv pip system installs, and trusted publishing to PyPI.

source.title: Installing uv
source.description: Guide to every install method (curl script, Homebrew, pipx, WinGet, Docker), upgrading with `uv self update`, shell autocompletion, and uninstalling.

source.title: Running scripts
source.description: `uv run` with per-invocation `--with` deps versus PEP 723 inline metadata (`uv init/add --script`), `--no-project` isolation, `uv lock --script` lockfiles, `exclude-newer` reproducibility, and shebangs.

source.title: Tools
source.description: `uvx` (disposable cached env) versus `uv tool install` (persistent, on `PATH`); version pinning with `@latest`, `uv tool upgrade`, `--with`/`--with-executables-from`, and differences from `uv run`.

source.title: Using tools
source.description: `uvx` for ephemeral isolated runs versus `uv tool install` for persistent `PATH` executables; `--from` selects package, version, extras or git source; `--with` adds plugins.

source.title: Caching
source.description: Concept guide: why local packages don't rebuild, forcing refresh or reinstall, dynamic-version rebuild triggers, clearing and pruning, CI strategy, and cache location.

source.title: Storage
source.description: Platform-specific locations (XDG on Unix, Known Folders on Windows) for cache, persistent data, config and executable directories, with `UV_TOOL_DIR`, `UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR`, `UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT` overrides.

source.title: Using uv with Dependabot
source.description: Enable `uv.lock` updates by adding the `uv` `package-ecosystem` to `dependabot.yml` `updates`, and match Dependabot `cooldown` days to uv's `exclude-newer` so locking succeeds.
